payload.text: Rules in force for dc: every host run, however small (one bats file, one prez AT, one shellcheck pass), "is booked by name with the booker vc names (utilz-vc since gtools-vc's handover of 19 Oct, on gtools-vc's decisions 59 and 62: a START, its GO, an END, on the board and by SendMessage)", and nothing runs without a GO; reading needs no window. Each START says light or heavy. Heavy runs go one at a time across both estates: any build, any whole suite (utilz test included), the estate gate, Chrome, a dry run or a cut, any test that starts a daemon. A light run (builds nothing, starts no GUI or daemon, binds no port, writes only its own temp dirs) may share the window with one heavy run, its GO given at a load under 60, and a failure that looks like timing is rerun alone before it counts. kovacs is a Parallels VM on rhadamanth, this Mac (kovacs-sysadm, 19 Oct): a kovacs leg writes no file here but loads this Mac through kovacs's two vCPUs, so its START says so; gtools-vc runs it beside a Mac run under decision 62 as amended. CI's shellcheck is 0.9.0, which flags A && B || C as SC2015 where 0.11.0 passes: run it under 0.9.0 (on kovacs, or the darwin build here under Rosetta) before handing on, with a control whose B and C are not echo. A portable stat puts GNU stat -c first. Estimates in t-shirt sizes, never wall-clock (hv, 19 Oct, through vc). No Hammerspoon, pointer, xcodebuild or hv's real keychain from dc; nothing on menuz's files, which are utilz-ic's; nothing pushed by dc.
